meta.title: Matrix
meta.description: Cross-config similarity across 17 channels, per measured set. Contrast-stretched or fixed [0,1] viridis; similarity is a measurement, not a quality score.

title: Matrix
subtitle: Every config against every other, across all 17 similarity channels.
honesty: Similarity is a measurement, not a quality score — it captures convergence, nothing else. Values are only comparable within one measured set — the same fixture.

session.none: No measured set on disk carries similarity data yet.

notice.sparse: {n} of {m} configs match the current filters — too few for a meaningful matrix.

order.label: order
order.title: Clustered order is computed from this view — it changes with the channel, variant, and filters.

width.label: width
width.title: Detail keeps every config name and scrolls horizontally. Fit puts the whole matrix in the viewport with model-cluster bands instead of names.

main.hint: Hover a cell to sync all 17 channels · click a cell for pair detail · click a header to open that config. The bordered diagonal is self-consistency.

multiples.title: 17 channels — pick one for the main view

channelDesc.v-phash: Perceptual hash — coarse whole-image visual fingerprint.
channelDesc.v-ssim: Structural similarity (SSIM) of the rendered image.
channelDesc.c-shingle: k-shingle overlap of the HTML/CSS source.
channelDesc.c-feature: Token feature-vector similarity of the source.
channelDesc.d-pqgram: pq-gram tree-edit similarity of the DOM.

drawer.title: Pair detail
drawer.subtitle: Two configs across all 17 channels. Similarity is a measurement, not a quality score.
drawer.aggregateNote: Median across non-empty slot-pairs, on the fixed [0,1] scale. A value only shows with enough effective comparisons (n_eff ≥ 4, and ≥2 valid slots per side for a cross pair); otherwise insufficient data, never a number.
drawer.perPairNote: Per-slot-pair values are shown raw (no gate) so the underlying distribution is fully visible — the gated aggregate above is what the matrix uses.
drawer.noDetail: no slot-pair detail materialized for this pair

empty.title: No configs match these filters
empty.message: No config in this measured set passes the current grade / arm filters. Reset to show every config.

merged.desc: All scored channels folded into one view: each channel is contrast-stretched over its own p5–p95 first (so no channel dominates by scale), then averaged. Diagnostic channels are excluded; a pair needs ≥6 contributing channels.
